name: Kamal Handbook
description: Long-form handbook for learning Kamal deployment and production operations.
details: A book-style alternative to collecting disconnected tutorials about server setup and day-two tasks.
best_for: You prefer a structured, start-to-finish learning resource.
caveat: Paid material; verify which Kamal releases are covered.

name: Kamal Wiki
description: Independent Kamal documentation and practical tutorial collection.
details: Supplemental community writing and operational examples outside the official docs.
best_for: You are looking for additional walkthroughs and alternative explanations.
caveat: Check article dates; older Kamal 1/MRSK examples may no longer apply.

name: Kamal Deep Dive — Rails World 2026
description: Josef Strzibny explains what happens during a Kamal deployment, from SSH execution to multi-server routing and Kamal Proxy.
details: Recorded at Rails World 2026, this talk walks through Kamal's architecture and a deployment from start to finish, including how servers, registries, and Kamal Proxy fit together.
best_for: You know the basic kamal deploy commands but want a deeper model of what happens on the servers and why.
caveat: A conference presentation rather than a current configuration reference; verify exact flags and options against the documentation for your installed Kamal version.
